# Scanned materials
These 1K photographic color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps are from Poly Haven and released under CC0.

- Aerial Grass Rock — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
- Aerial Asphalt 01 — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_asphalt_01
- Brick Wall 003 — Dimitrios Savva and Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/brick_wall_003

License: https://polyhaven.com/license

Architecture, road geometry, facades, vegetation layout, terrain and water shader are generated by the application. Cities: Skylines II screenshots are used only as visual references and are not included in this repository.

Detailed window/door meshes and their PBR textures are adapted from [Modular Urban Apartments Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade), James Ray Cock / Poly Haven, CC0. The shipped glTF contains three selected modules and a compacted buffer. The original kit is not shipped in full.

## Edition 7 rendering assets

- Additional wall, window, door and crown geometry and PBR materials from
  [Modular Urban Apartments Facade](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_urban_apartments_facade),
  James Ray Cock / Poly Haven. CC0. Five selected modules; unused geometry,
  materials and textures removed from the glTF.
- [Pine Sapling Small](https://polyhaven.com/a/pine_sapling_small), Rico Cilliers
  (modeling) and Rob Tuytel (photography) / Poly Haven. CC0. One selected tree
  variant, normalized at runtime; geometry used nearby, rendered impostors farther away.
- [Tree Small 02](https://polyhaven.com/a/tree_small_02), Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven.
  CC0. Four transparent 640×768 views rendered from the source 3D model for
  efficient broadleaf vegetation. The high-polygon source is not distributed.
- [Syferfontein 1d Clear](https://polyhaven.com/a/syferfontein_1d_clear),
  Poly Haven. CC0. 1K HDR environment for daylight, sky and reflections.

All Poly Haven assets above: https://polyhaven.com/license
RGBELoader is Three.js r170, MIT, alongside the existing Three.js license.

## Edition 10 close-range vegetation

Tree Small 02 by Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven (CC0) is also supplied as a simplified 3D GLB for nearby trees. Reduced with glTF Transform/meshoptimizer to a target 2% geometry ratio, with textures resized to 512 pixels. Distant trees retain the rendered views.

## Edition 12 terrain

[Rock Face 03](https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_face_03), Poly Haven, CC0. The 1K diffuse and OpenGL normal maps are used for exposed terrain. License: https://polyhaven.com/license
